cohort: The study recruited 139 two-year-old children, 112 of whom were born to mothers with SCH-TPOAb- and 27 to euthyroid TPOAb- mothers.
finding: Children whose mothers had SCH-TPOAb- with TSH levels between 4.0 and 10.0 mIU/L and received no treatment showed significantly lower intellectual development (DQ) at two years of age compared to controls, suggesting that early standardized treatment may improve outcomes.
